meta.description: Seed dataset of Tamil-English code-mixed scam/misinformation message patterns and safe control messages for the Meiyaa detector.
meta.license_note: Reconstructed representative examples based on publicly reported scam/misinformation patterns (news reports, CERT-In/RBI advisories, fact-checking orgs). Not verbatim copies of any individual's private messages.

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Congratulations! You are shortlisted for Part Time Work From Home Job. Daily earn Rs.3000-5000. No experience needed. Registration fee Rs.499 only. WhatsApp HR now: +91-9xxxxxxxxx
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on widely reported WFH job-scam template (LocalCircles 2025 survey; task-based job scams)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Vanakkam sir/madam, ungalukku Amazon company la Part Time Online Job kedaikum. Daily 2 hours work pannina 1500 rupees kudupom. Interested na intha number ku WhatsApp pannunga. Registration fee 300 rs mattum.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on reported HR-impersonation task job scams

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: வணக்கம்! உங்களுக்கு Flipkart நிறுவனத்தில் Work From Home வேலை உறுதி செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது. நாள் ஒன்றுக்கு ரூ.2000 சம்பாதிக்கலாம். சேர விவரங்களுக்கு இந்த எண்ணுக்கு WhatsApp செய்யவும். பதிவு கட்டணம் ரூ.499 மட்டும்.
red_flags: advance fee before any real interview
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on e-commerce HR impersonation scams reported in Bengaluru freelance-gig cases

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: HR Team here. You've been selected for Data Entry job, salary 25000/month. Send Aadhaar card copy and pay Rs.999 refundable security deposit to activate your employee ID.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on data-entry/task job fraud reports

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Hi bro, naan Swiggy la HR. Ungaluku part time delivery partner job iruku, daily 1200-1800 sambadhikalam. Kit fee 800 rs pay pannunga, adhuku bank la refund aagum.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on gig-economy delivery partner fraud

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: You have been shortlisted for an online task-based job. Complete simple app-rating tasks and earn commission. Join our Telegram group for task assignments and initial investment guidance.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on task-scam/'e-commerce rating job' fraud (₹1.2 lakh Bengaluru case reported)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: உங்கள் Resume Naukri.com மூலம் தேர்வு செய்யப்பட்டது. Interview இல்லாமல் நேரடியாக Offer Letter வழங்கப்படும். Processing charge ரூ.1500 UPI மூலம் அனுப்பவும்.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on portal-impersonation job offer scams

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Google is hiring freshers for remote content moderator role. Salary 40k/month. To secure your slot pay one time training fee of Rs.1200. Limited seats only, apply today.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on major-brand-impersonation remote job scams

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Instant Personal Loan Approved! Get up to Rs.5,00,000 with NO CIBIL check, NO documents. Disbursal within 30 minutes. Pay processing fee Rs.799 to release loan amount.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on RBI/CERT-In advisories on fake loan apps and Billcut-reported case (Aftab, Bareilly)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Sir unga mobile number la 2 lakhs loan pre-approved aayiruku. Zero interest first month. Aadhaar, PAN photo anuppi 500 rs processing fee pannunga, aprm loan amount account ku varum.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake loan-app/WhatsApp loan fraud reports

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: வாழ்த்துக்கள்! உங்களுக்கு ரூ.1,00,000 Personal Loan எந்த ஆவணமும் இல்லாமல் அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்டது. Loan வழங்க செயலாக்க கட்டணம் ரூ.999 UPI மூலம் அனுப்பவும்.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on WhatsApp loan-scam advisories (RBL Bank, CERT-In)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Dear Customer, your loan application with XYZ Finance is approved for Rs.3,00,000. To avoid cancellation, share your Aadhaar, PAN and bank OTP for final verification within 1 hour.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on OTP-linked fake loan approval fraud (CERT-In advisory)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Nanba, unga CIBIL score kammiya irundhalum problem illa. Naan agent, 50000 loan arrange pannuren, ஆனா முதல்ல 799 registration kattanum. Trust பண்ணுங்க, bank employee than.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on informal loan-agent WhatsApp fraud

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Congratulations! Your loan of Rs 2 lakh has been sanctioned by our NBFC partner. Download this APK to check status and complete e-KYC: bit.ly/loan-status-check
red_flags: prompts APK download outside app stores
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake loan-app malware distribution reported by CERT-In/McAfee

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Your bank account will be blocked today due to KYC non-compliance. Share the OTP sent to your number immediately to keep your account active. Call 1800-XXX-XXXX now.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on CERT-In KYC/OTP phishing advisory (ICICI Bank KYC WhatsApp case, Pune CA, March 2025)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Hi, naan unga cousin Ravi. Emergency, oru payment panna OTP varum, adha enakku sollunga please, urgent.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on 'hacked friend/relative OTP' scam reported widely (Bengaluru case)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: உங்கள் Paytm KYC காலாவதியாகிறது. இன்று மாலைக்குள் புதுப்பிக்கவில்லை எனில் கணக்கு முடக்கப்படும். இந்த லிங்கை கிளிக் செய்து OTP உள்ளிடவும்: bit.ly/paytm-kyc-update
red_flags: requests OTP entry on fake page
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on widely reported Paytm/UPI KYC phishing SMS

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: We noticed an unauthorized login attempt on your account. To secure your account, please reply with the 6-digit OTP you just received.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on account-takeover OTP phishing (CERT-In advisory)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Customer Care here. Neenga refund ku apply pannirukinga, adha process panna oru OTP varum, adha sollunga, transaction reverse aagum.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake-refund OTP scam (Ahmedabad case reported, ₹40,000 loss)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Your parcel could not be delivered due to incomplete address. Verify by entering the OTP sent to you or your order will be cancelled and refund forfeited.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on courier/e-commerce delivery OTP scam (CERT-In list of common OTP frauds)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: வங்கி எச்சரிக்கை: உங்கள் கணக்கில் சந்தேகத்திற்குரிய பரிவர்த்தனை கண்டறியப்பட்டது. ரத்து செய்ய இந்த எண்ணிற்கு அழைத்து OTP ஐ உறுதிப்படுத்தவும்.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake bank fraud-alert OTP scam

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Your electricity bill is unpaid and power will be disconnected tonight. Pay immediately via this link and enter OTP to confirm: electricity-billpay-secure.info
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on electricity bill / utility disconnection SMS scams (CERT-In advisories)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: URGENT ALERT: Avoid eating papaya and non-veg for next 10 days, WHO confirms it worsens dengue fever. Doctors advised to drink only goat milk. Forward to save lives!
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented dengue-related WhatsApp health hoaxes (BOOM fact-check report)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: Nalla news!! Papaya leaf juice 48 mani neram la dengue fever ah completely cure pannidum nu doctors sonnanga. Free ah kedaikum, ella hospital layum available. Ellarukum share pannunga.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on papaya-leaf-cures-dengue hoax (BOOM/Check4Spam documented forward)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: எச்சரிக்கை! இந்த மாத்திரையில் 'மச்சுபோ' வைரஸ் உள்ளது என மருத்துவர்கள் தெரிவித்துள்ளனர். இதை உடனே பயன்படுத்துவதை நிறுத்தி, அனைவருக்கும் இதை பகிரவும்.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented 'Machupo virus in painkillers' WhatsApp hoax (NPR/Check4Spam)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: Breaking: New study proves drinking hot water with lemon every morning cures diabetes permanently without medicine. Stop your tablets and try this for 7 days, share with diabetic friends.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented diabetes home-remedy hoaxes (BOOM report on wheat/barley diabetes myths)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: Coconut oil daily 2 spoon sappitta dengue platelet count seekirama uyarum nu top hospital doctors confirm pannirukanga. Chemical medicine venaam, ithu mattum podhum.
red_flags: false medical claim discouraging real treatment
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on coconut-oil-cures-dengue hoax (BOOM fact-check compilation)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: பசுவின் பாலில் பாம்பு விஷம் கலந்திருப்பதாக சந்தேகிக்கப்படும் நிகழ்வு அறிக்கை வெளியானது. பால் குடிப்பதை தற்காலிகமாக நிறுத்தி வையுங்கள். இதை உடனே அனைவருக்கும் அனுப்புங்கள்.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on long-documented 'snake venom in milk' hoax (Check4Spam/NPR reported)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: Alert from UNICEF: Avoid cold drinks and ice cream for next 3 days, a new virus spreads through cold food items. Government has not announced this to avoid panic, please forward to protect family.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented fake-UNICEF coronavirus advisory hoax cited in Senate letter to Facebook/WhatsApp

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: Bitter gourd (pavakkai) juice daily kudichaa corona virus 100% kill aagum nu ஒரு government doctor sonnanga interview la. Idha ellarukkum share pannunga, life save pannunga.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented bitter-gourd-cures-coronavirus hoax (cited in US Senate letter re: WhatsApp misinformation)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: CONGRATULATIONS! Your mobile number has won Rs.25,00,000 in the KBC Lucky Draw 2026. To claim your prize, pay Rs.5,000 registration/tax fee. Contact Mr. Sharma: +91-7xxxxxxxxx
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on widely reported KBC lottery scam template

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Vanakkam! Ungaluku Coca-Cola company Lucky Draw la 10,00,000 rupees prize adichirukku. Vாங்க இந்த prize-a claim panna 5000 rs processing fee anuppunga.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented Coca-Cola lucky-draw scam template (bighow news)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: வாழ்த்துக்கள்! உங்கள் எண் Airtel நிறுவனத்தின் 25வது ஆண்டு நிறைவு லக்கி டிரா-வில் ரூ.15,00,000 வென்றுள்ளது. பரிசு பெற ரூ.3,000 GST கட்டணம் செலுத்தவும்.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on telecom-anniversary lucky draw scam template

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: You have been selected for a WhatsApp Lucky Winner Prize of an iPhone 16 Pro. Claim now by clicking the link and sharing this message with 5 groups to unlock your gift.
red_flags: forward-to-unlock trick used for virality/data harvesting
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented WhatsApp Gold/fake giveaway forward scam

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Sir, neenga ungal number vachu free ah Royal Enfield bike win pannirukinga oru online survey mூலம். Delivery charge 1500 rs pay panna bike unga veetuku varum.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake vehicle-giveaway courier-fee scam pattern

messages.label: not_scam
messages.message_text: Your OTP for HDFC Bank net banking login is 482913. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff.
red_flags: none - this is a genuine transactional OTP message that explicitly warns not to share it
messages.source_pattern_note: Example of genuine bank-format OTP message for contrast/negative class

messages.label: not_scam
messages.message_text: Anna, naalaikku meeting 10 mani ku office la, konjam late aagalam nu sonnanga boss. Reminder anupparen.
messages.source_pattern_note: Everyday Tanglish message for negative class balance

messages.label: not_scam
messages.message_text: அம்மா, நாளைக்கு டாக்டர் அப்பாயின்ட்மென்ட் மதியம் 3 மணிக்கு உள்ளது. மறக்காமல் வாங்க.
messages.source_pattern_note: Everyday Tamil message for negative class balance

messages.label: not_scam
messages.message_text: Your Swiggy order #4521 has been delivered. Rate your delivery experience in the app. Thank you for ordering with us!
red_flags: none - standard post-delivery notification, no request for money/OTP/personal data
messages.source_pattern_note: Example of legitimate e-commerce notification for negative class

messages.label: not_scam
messages.message_text: Da, indha weekend ooru poi varalam nu irukken, ticket book pannitiya? Confirm pannu.
messages.source_pattern_note: Everyday Tanglish message for negative class balance

messages.label: not_scam
messages.message_text: Reminder: Your electricity bill of Rs.1,240 for connection no. 1023456 is due on 28th. Pay via the official TANGEDCO app or website to avoid late fee.
red_flags: none - directs to official app/website rather than a link/OTP, no urgency threats
messages.source_pattern_note: Example of genuine utility bill reminder for negative class contrast

messages.label: not_scam
messages.message_text: பள்ளி நாளை விடுமுறை என அறிவிக்கப்படுகிறது. மாணவர்கள் திங்கட்கிழமை வழக்கம்போல் வரவும்.
messages.source_pattern_note: Everyday Tamil announcement for negative class balance

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: We are hiring Typists for Home Based Typing Job. No target, no fear. Earn Rs.20-25 per page. Kit and ID card charge Rs.850 (fully refundable after 1 month).
red_flags: refundable kit fee that is never refunded
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on classic home-based typing job scam circulated via SMS/WhatsApp for years

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Hi, Zomato la delivery boy vacancy iruku, license venaam, bike venaam, company than bike kudukum. Registration ku 650 rs pay pannunga, bike 2 naala home delivery aagum.
red_flags: company providing free bike is implausible
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on delivery-partner recruitment fraud

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Earn Rs.50,000/month by liking YouTube videos and subscribing to channels. Simple task, no skills required. Message us to get your task ID and starter kit fee of Rs.300.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on 'like and earn' task-scam template widely reported by cyber cells

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: TCS நிறுவனத்தில் Work From Home வாய்ப்பு! எந்த தகுதியும் தேவையில்லை. மாதம் ரூ.35,000 உறுதி. விவரங்களுக்கு இந்த வாட்ஸ்அப் குழுவில் இணையவும், நுழைவு கட்டணம் ரூ.599.
red_flags: no qualification needed for high salary (red flag)
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on IT-major impersonation WFH scam

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Airlines cabin crew hiring drive - work abroad, salary in USD. Send passport copy and pay Rs.2000 visa processing assistance fee to HR WhatsApp number to proceed.
red_flags: overseas job with upfront visa fee
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on overseas job/visa-fee recruitment fraud reported by MEA advisories

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Naanga oru MNC company, freshers ku data entry job kudukurom, work from home, laptop venaam mobile la pannalam. First month training fee 450 rs mattum, apram salary start aagum.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on vague-employer data entry scam

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Pre-approved Business Loan of Rs.10,00,000 available for you at 2% interest only. No collateral, no guarantor. Reply YES to get funds credited within 24 hours after Rs.1500 verification charge.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake business-loan WhatsApp fraud

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Bro unga salary account paatha loan easy ah sanction aagum nu bank agent sonnanga. Aana munnadi oru 'insurance charge' 1200 rs kattanum, apram loan full ah release aagum.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake bank-agent WhatsApp loan fraud

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: உங்கள் Aadhaar எண் அடிப்படையில் ரூ.50,000 Instant Loan அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த APK-ஐ பதிவிறக்கம் செய்து e-KYC முடிக்கவும்: bit.ly/instant-loan-kyc
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake loan-app APK malware distribution (CERT-In/McAfee advisories)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Student Education Loan Scheme - Govt subsidized, 0% interest for first year. Apply now by paying Rs.999 application fee, funds disbursed directly to college within 48 hours.
red_flags: application fee for a 'subsidized' loan (real govt schemes don't charge this)
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake government education-loan scheme scam

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Madam, unga husband name la already 1 lakh loan approve aagiruku, ஆனா withdraw panna Aadhaar OTP verify pannanum, sollunga naan process pannitren.
red_flags: third-party requesting OTP on someone else's behalf
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on family-impersonation OTP loan fraud

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: SBI ALERT: Your account is temporarily suspended due to PAN-Aadhaar link pending. Update immediately by sharing OTP or visit nearest ATM within 2 hours to avoid permanent block.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on SBI/bank-impersonation PAN-Aadhaar linking phishing SMS

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Naan Flipkart delivery agent, unga order return panna oru OTP varum apo, adha sollunga confirm pannitu return pickup pannuren.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on e-commerce return/delivery OTP scam

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: உங்கள் Jio சிம் இன்று இரவு முடக்கப்படும் ஏனெனில் KYC நிலுவையில் உள்ளது. இந்த எண்ணை அழைத்து OTP கூறி மறு சரிபார்ப்பு செய்யவும்: 1800-XXX-XXXX
red_flags: OTP over call to fake helpline
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on telecom SIM-block KYC OTP phishing scam widely reported by TRAI advisories

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Your credit card reward points worth Rs.8,500 are expiring today. Redeem now by verifying with the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
red_flags: fake expiring rewards to create urgency
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on credit-card rewards-expiry OTP scam

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Hi sir, IT department here, unga income tax refund 12,400 rs pending. Process panna oru OTP varum, athai confirm pannunga refund credit aagum.
red_flags: no official IT dept channel uses SMS/WhatsApp OTP requests
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on Income Tax refund scam SMS/WhatsApp (McAfee India advisory)

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Your WhatsApp account will be deactivated in 24 hours due to a policy violation. To keep your account active, share the verification code you just received with support.
red_flags: requests verification/OTP code (leads to account takeover)
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on WhatsApp account-hijack OTP scam (moneylife.in reported case)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: Doctors warn: Do not take Combiflam tablets, they contain a banned chemical causing sudden death. Several deaths reported this week. Share this to save someone's life today.
red_flags: fabricated medical danger claim about a common medicine
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented Combiflam-danger hoax (BOOM fact-check compilation)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: 5G towers vந்தததுல தான் இப்போ corona cases athigama aagudhu nu scientists sonnanga. Veetu அருகில் tower irundha immediate ah complaint pannunga.
red_flags: false causal link between 5G and virus spread
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on widely documented 5G-coronavirus conspiracy hoax

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: வெங்காயத்தை தலையணைக்கு அடியில் வைத்து தூங்கினால் சர்க்கரை நோய் (சுகர்) குணமாகிவிடும் என ஆயுர்வேத மருத்துவர் தெரிவித்துள்ளார். மாத்திரைகளை நிறுத்திவிட்டு இதை முயற்சி செய்யவும்.
red_flags: advises stopping medication for a serious condition
folk remedy presented as verified cure
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on widely circulated onion/folk-remedy diabetes-cure hoax (THIP-reported influencer misinformation)

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: WARNING: Eating watermelon and drinking water together immediately causes food poisoning and has killed 3 people this week in Chennai. Please inform family members urgently.
red_flags: unverifiable death count tied to a specific city
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on classic recycled food-combination death hoax

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: Ice cream fridge la konjam neram vachurundha adhula bacteria grow aagi cancer varum nu WHO recent ah warning kudutha, ice cream company sonnadhu ellam poi.
red_flags: false WHO attribution about ice cream causing cancer
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on generic food-safety-panic hoax template attributed to WHO

messages.label: misinformation
messages.message_text: கொரோனா தடுப்பூசி எடுத்தவர்களுக்கு 5 வருடங்களில் பக்க விளைவுகள் தொடங்கும் என புதிய ஆராய்ச்சி தெரிவிக்கிறது. தடுப்பூசி எடுக்காதவர்கள் கவலைப்பட வேண்டாம், இதை பகிரவும்.
red_flags: unverified vaccine side-effect claim with vague 'new research'
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on documented vaccine-hesitancy misinformation forwards flagged by MCA/fact-checking units

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Your WhatsApp number is one of 10 lucky winners of Rs.10,00,000 in the Jio 10th Anniversary Draw. Claim by sending your bank details and paying Rs.2,500 GST clearance fee.
red_flags: asks for bank details plus advance fee
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on telecom-anniversary lucky draw scam variants

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: Ungaluku Amazon Anniversary Sale Lucky Draw la Innova Crysta car free ah kedaichirikku. Delivery, RC transfer charge 4500 rs mattum kattunga, veetuku kondu vந்து தருவோம்.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake e-commerce anniversary sale car-giveaway scam

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: GOOGLE PROMO WINNER: Your email ID has been randomly selected for the Google 25th Anniversary cash reward of $50,000. Contact our claims agent immediately with your bank IFSC code.
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on long-standing Google/Microsoft lottery email-and-SMS scam template

messages.label: scam
messages.message_text: வாழ்த்துக்கள்! தமிழ்நாடு அரசு புத்தாண்டு லக்கி டிரா-வில் உங்கள் எண் ரூ.5,00,000 வென்றுள்ளது. பரிசை பெற ஆதார், வங்கி விவரங்களுடன் ரூ.1000 அனுப்பவும்.
red_flags: requests Aadhaar and bank details plus fee
messages.source_pattern_note: Pattern based on fake-government-scheme lottery scam template
